title.narrative: Initiation of the HCFC phase out in the Republic of Azerbaijan

description.narrative: The programme is consistent with the country#s priorities and commitments to fulfill its obligations under Montreal Protocol. It is designed to strengthen the national monitoring and legislative system established for CFC phase out, which was completed in January 2006. The project#s primary goal is to develop and implement country strategies for HCFC phase out based the most recent surveys of HCFC consumption and to ensure an adequate institutional capacity is put in place, and formalised in a National HCFC Phase out Strategy and Action Plan
